Title: Small request for the online cardlists

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Now that the Nights of Reckoning "Rule Cards" are legal for play in
Constructed tournaments, would it be possible to put a small designation
next to these cards in the online cardlists on the website? (something
like "NoR:RC"?)

Not a big deal, but I thought it might be useful to keep track of these
cards...

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Now that the Nights of Reckoning "Rule Cards" are legal for play in
> Constructed tournaments, would it be possible to put a small designation
> next to these cards in the online cardlists on the website? (something
> like "NoR:RC"?)

No. That would make it seem like the NoR card was the most recent
printing (with all that that entails). The NoR rules cards are not the
most recent printing of the corresponding cards, from the "what is the
official text" point of view, so they won't be listed as such in the
"what is the official text" documents.

Messages.Author: Greg
Messages.Body:


Then list them before the most recent printing.

--
- Gregory Stuart Pettigrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Greg wrote:
> Then list them before the most recent printing.

They're listed in chronological order.
Besides, the information is not interesting -- the cards are common and
have been printed several times before, with art. Having a rules card
version is not interesting (except in draft).
